newsitem.title: GERMANY: Pan-German Aug industry orders rise for 3rd month.
newsitem.headline: Pan-German Aug industry orders rise for 3rd month.

text.p: Industrial orders in Germany rose 0.6 percent in August from July, the third consecutive monthly rise, but slowed slightly from a 0.9 percent increase in July, the economics ministry said.
Orders were up 4.4 percent from the year-earlier level, jumping from a 0.5 percent increase in July, according to Bundesbank data.
Domestic orders were down 1.0 percent frome the previous month, while foreign orders rose 3.0 percent.
In west Germany, orders rose 0.6 percent from July and 4.8 percent from the year-earlier month, while in east Germany they fell 3.6 percent and 4.9 percent respectively.
